ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: expand NSW accordions: remove hidden="until-found" from .nsw-accordion__content, set aria-expanded=true
ledger.why: collapsed panels are absent from innerText — same class as N-D2 hidden slides; the reskin renders every panel body (Figma Accordion expanded variant 12362:10348)

ledger.what: remove Material Icons ligature spans (.material-icons: keyboard_arrow_down, east, north)
ledger.why: aria-hidden decorative glyphs whose ligature names leak into innerText; donor supplies its own chevron/arrow glyphs via CSS (mapping-brief § Icon-ligature text, "normalize it away")

metadata.title: NSW public school information
metadata.description: Our school is one of more than 2,200 NSW public schools working together to give every student a strong start in life. Being part of this network means your child benefits from consistent policies, shared values, high teaching standards and access to statewide resources, assets, programs and support.

visibleTextNormalized: NSW public school information This page includes updates and messages from the NSW Department of Education. It brings together content that applies to families of all NSW public schools. Understanding school policies Want to know how things like behaviour, attendance or mobile phone use are handled in NSW public schools? Our school follows policies set by the NSW Department of Education. These policies guide our school practices to provide a safe, fair and supportive environment for every student and help families understand what to expect from us. To learn more, visit the department's Policy library today. Policy Library Have a question? We’re here to help with information for all NSW public school families. Reach out for more information. Contact us Our policies and reports Discover our local school policies, reports and plans. Our principal and staff Get to know our principal and staff, who work together to create a positive school culture.
